criteria.requirement: Fix _front_matter_rule to check the current scanned line for the existing triple-dot terminator, consuming it exactly once while excluding it from token.content and including it in the half-open token.map. Closing at EOF, empty metadata and trailing horizontal whitespace must work and preserve the first body line. Keep existing dash delimiters, initial-document-only recognition, insufficient/open-without-close fallback and hidden/block/markup behavior. Four dots or noninitial blocks must not be silently accepted as metadata.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
